name: TaskManager
observations: Background task manager inspired by Celery and BullMQ
Features worker management, scheduled/cron jobs, live metrics, and dead letter queue
Target UI aligns with DESIGN.md Linear Dark design system
Feature ft-01-taskmanager-core completed with 20/20 tests passing and zero spec drift
Includes in-app worker spawner, backpressure guardrails, and Redis maintenance flush

name: BackendEngine
observations: Built with Python, FastAPI, and Redis
Manages job queueing, worker heartbeats, cron schedules, and WebSockets for real-time updates
Supports automated in-memory Redis fallback for zero-dependency development on Windows/macOS/Linux
Embeds Scheduler daemon loop in FastAPI lifespan with distributed Redis leader locking and local timezone evaluation

name: FrontendDashboard
observations: Minimalist SPA dashboard built with modern vanilla JavaScript and CSS
Complies with DESIGN.md color palette (#010102 canvas, #5e6ad2 primary accent) and typography
Uses Linear Dark Toast notifications exclusively instead of browser alert() or confirm() popups
Provides real-time queue status table, Tempo trace timeline, Loki logs viewer, and Redis maintenance modal
Features unified +Criar dropdown action menu, Ctrl+K command palette, and Linear micro-action table row rhythm

name: RedisBroker
observations: Acts as the message broker and state storage for job queues, worker heartbeats, and pub/sub events
Configured for AOF appendonly yes with appendfsync everysec and maxmemory-policy noeviction to guarantee zero data loss on reboots
Includes check_persistence_health diagnostics and atomic flush routines: flush_queues, flush_history, and flush_all

name: InAppWorkerManager
observations: Enables dynamic worker spawning via Web UI and REST API (/api/workers/spawn)
Supports pause, resume, and stop controls via Redis pub/sub commands
Implements resource guardrails for max CPU% and max RSS Memory MB with throttled backpressure

name: WindowsSubprocessUTF8
observations: Enforces PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 and PYTHONUTF8=1 in subprocess environments to prevent CP1252 UnicodeEncodeError with emojis on Windows

name: user:developer
observations: Prefers uv for Python package management, virtual environment isolation, and script running
Rejects browser alert/confirm popups in favor of modern toast notifications
Prefers managing workers and Redis maintenance directly from the Web UI
Developing in a Windows environment without hardware virtualization

name: LibraryPackaging
observations: Supports wheel bundling of taskmanager.ui static assets (HTML/CSS/JS) via pyproject.toml package-data
Provides TaskManager top-level convenience class for mounting into FastAPI (app.mount) and Django (INSTALLED_APPS + urls)
UI SPA dashboard adapts dynamically to subpath mounting (BASE_PATH detection and relative asset paths)
Includes full reference samples in samples/ (fastapi_sample, django_sample, standalone_cli)

name: RealtimeProgressAndLogStreaming
observations: Provides TaskContext for tasks to update real-time progress (0-100%) and append log stream
Auto-injects TaskContext into worker task invocations based on function signature introspection
Subprocess execution in system.run_command streams stdout/stderr line-by-line asynchronously
Emits job:progress and job:log events via Redis Pub/Sub and relays over WebSockets to UI
Linear Dark SPA renders animated progress bars in History table and live logs in Loki console

name: NativeObservabilitySuite
observations: Calculates time-series throughput buckets, latency distribution histograms, and P50-P99 percentiles from Redis history
Exposes GET /api/metrics/timeseries with dynamic window_minutes parameter (15m, 30m, 1h, 24h)
Renders high-performance interactive area charts via HTML5 Canvas with DPI scaling without Prometheus/Grafana CDN overhead
Complies with Linear Dark design tokens: canvas #010102, primary line #5e6ad2, error #ef4444

name: AlertChannelsEngine
observations: Multi-platform webhook notification system supporting Slack, Discord, Microsoft Teams, Telegram, and generic HTTP Webhooks
Dispatches formatted rich payloads asynchronously upon permanent job failures and DLQ routing
Provides Redis persistence in tm:alerts:channels and full REST API (/api/alerts/channels) with test ping functionality
UI management modal with live test triggers, platform badge indicators, and dynamic credential fields

name: RateLimitingAndConcurrencyEngine
observations: Distributed Token Bucket Rate Limiter with human-friendly syntax (10/s, 100/m, 1000/h, 5000/d) in taskmanager.core.limiter
Cluster-wide concurrency semaphore per task backed by Redis sorted sets with auto-pruning
Worker runtime gracefully reschedules jobs reaching rate limits or concurrency caps into delayed zset without consuming retries
Exposed via @task(rate_limit=..., max_concurrency=...) and rendered with visual badges in Dashboard
